![](owen.jpg){.float-end width="300"}

Owen leads the group's work on ecological forecasting — understanding food
webs and ecological communities well enough to predict how they change.

## Organising roles

- [Response Diversity Network](https://responsediversitynetwork.github.io/RDN-website/){target="_blank"} — Co-founder (with Sam Ross), Steering Committee member, Leadership Team Chair
- [European Chapter of the Ecological Forecasting Initiative](https://euro-ecoforecast.wordpress.com/){target="_blank"} — Founding member, Steering Committee member
- [World Biodiversity Forum](https://worldbiodiversityforum.org/){target="_blank"} — Scientific Steering Committee member, Co-founder (with Bernhard Schmid and Michael Schaepman)
